item.text:
Implemented `StoreGraph.loadPickupLocations.execute(postcode:)`.

Design note: The use case rejects blank postcodes before calling the API and forwards nonblank input unchanged. The repository reuses `PickupCatalog.available` for filtering, first-eligible deduplication, and title/ID sorting, plus the existing transport failure mapping.

Validation: `swift test` passed all 5 tests, including existing feature checks. `git diff --check` passed.
